method: Exact intersection of previously saved per-bird eligible IDs. No GPS values re-opened, no new model or permutation, no new individual-stationary scores.

scientific_boundary.justified: 33 L. fuscus individuals (and hence their 2021 tags) enter both separately analyzed flying and low-speed panels. Within this intersecting group, 30 have positive flight point-score signs.
scientific_boundary.not_justified: The same 30 birds have significant stationary signals or the magnitude of flight and stationary shape information is correlated at the individual level. Per-bird stationary gains were not saved in the stationary receipt; joint cross-context effect correlations are untested.
scientific_boundary.inference: Both context-level results concern largely overlapping individuals/tags, strengthening relevance of instrument and micro-perch alternatives without causally separating them.
